answer.summary: Formulate a bounded, empirically grounded research question on memory persistence versus reported retention in tokenized agents using only directly cited metrics from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1
answer.content: The research question must examine the relationship between observed memory persistence and explicitly reported retention rates in a tokenized agent under periodic input with known perturbations, restricting analysis to metrics directly cited and quantified in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1. The question must exclude any inferred, indirect, or unreported dynamics and must be verifiable through the source material alone. Acceptance criteria: the question must reference only directly reported retention values, be testable against observable data, and avoid speculative or downstream inferences without explicit support in the source text. No assumptions beyond what is explicitly stated in the cited section are permitted.
